## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and why the change is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm lint`

## Project records

- [ ] I updated `docs/PRD.md` if requirements, scope, or acceptance criteria changed.
- [ ] I updated `PLAN.md` or `PROJECT_SETUP_PLAN.md` if delivery state or sequencing changed.
- [ ] I added or superseded an ADR if this introduces a durable architectural decision.
- [ ] I added a Changeset for a published runtime, API, or styling-contract change, or this change is documentation-only/unpublished.
